summary: EXPLORE (Navigation Fork Phase 1) verified end-to-end on the live preview build (frontend only). All 7 acceptance flows PASS. (1) LANDING: after onboarding (welcome-go -> region-canada -> interests-next -> onboard-search 'Minnesota' -> result-team-MINN -> onboard-skip x3), tapping nav-explore renders hero 'Take me somewhere in hockey.', kicker 'EXPLORE THE TICKER', explore-search, world pills world-elite/world-all/world-youth, and a horizontal 'PICK A LEAGUE' rail with explore-league-nhl/-whl/-ohl/-qmjhl/-ncaa all present. (2) SEARCH ENTRANCE: explore-search routes to /search and resolves 'montreal' -> Canadiens (MTL) in the results. (3) WANDER WHL: tapping explore-league-whl inline-unfolds a drill panel with WHL crests explore-team-BDN/-SAS/-REG/-PA (all four confirmed), a LEAGUE HUB button (explore-hub-whl), and 'Surprise me' (explore-surprise). Tapping explore-team-BDN opens /team/BDN?league=whl (real Wheat Kings page with '#1 East Division', roster, next-game — correct WHL Team Page). Back returns to Explore with the WHL panel STILL OPEN (state preserved). explore-hub-whl navigates to /league/whl. (4) NHL DRILL: explore-league-nhl unfolds real NHL crests (first tile explore-team-CAR); tapping opens /team/CAR (correct Hurricanes team page). Back retraces to Explore with NHL card still visible. (5) WORLD LENSES: world-elite and world-all both render the league rail (all data is elite). world-youth renders the HONEST placeholder — 'Youth & local hockey is coming' copy, sample-path chips Canada > British Columbia > Kamloops > Association, 'SAMPLE PATH · COMING SOON' label, and 'Explore the elite game for now' CTA. Crucially NO explore-team-* elements exist under youth and league rail is hidden. Under world-all the explore-youth-teaser is present and switches world to youth. (6) SURPRISE ME: with WHL open, tapping explore-surprise navigated to /team/PG?league=whl (Prince George Cougars — random real WHL team). (7) REGRESSION: bottom nav shows 5 tabs (nav-home / nav-myhockey / nav-games / nav-explore / nav-profile — testIDs verified against BottomNav.tsx L20-24). Universal /search still resolves entities. No red-screen errors. Only pre-existing RN-Web 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' warning observed — carry-over, not introduced by this change. Deprecated Expo packages detected: none. React-Native issues detected: none new.

react_native_issues.issue: RN Web emits 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' at boot. Pre-existing across screens; not caused by ExploreScreen changes.

action_items: (Optional carry-over) Migrate remaining shadow* style props to boxShadow to silence RN web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: ExploreScreen.tsx cleanly reuses existing plumbing: api.leagues() for availability, api.nhlStandings()/api.leagueStandings(code) for real crests, setCtxLeague on drill-in so the shared LeagueContext is primed for downstream screens, router.push('/team/${abbr}${code!=='nhl'?`?league=${code}`:''}') for correct multi-league team routing, router.push(`/league/${code}`) for hub. Nothing rebuilt.
Youth lens is an honest placeholder: no explore-team-* rendered, sample path chips are non-Pressable Views, single CTA switches world back to 'elite'. Matches spec exactly (no fabricated youth data).
world-all correctly renders both the league rail AND the explore-youth-teaser (Pressable that flips world to 'youth') — teaser is the ONLY bridge to youth from world-all.

State preservation: `open` league state persists across router.back() because ExploreScreen isn't unmounted (Expo Router keeps tab siblings mounted). Verified — WHL/NHL panels remain open after returning from a Team Page.

All interactive elements have testID (explore-search, world-<w>, explore-league-<code>, explore-team-<ABBR>, explore-hub-<code>, explore-surprise, explore-youth-teaser). All text wrapped in Text. All styles via StyleSheet.create.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (7/7 acceptance flows pass: landing composition, SEARCH doorway, WHL drill + real team + hub + back-preserves-open, NHL drill + real team page, three world lenses + honest youth + world-all teaser, Surprise me lands on random real WHL team, 5-tab bottom-nav regression)

seed_data_creation: None — live standings data (NHL/WHL). Onboarded 1 follow (team MINN via 'Minnesota' search) to exit onboarding.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Explore Phase 1 is fully in place. Onboard: /onboarding?reset=1 -> welcome-go -> region-canada -> interests-next -> onboard-search 'Minnesota' -> click first result-team-* (MINN) -> onboard-skip x3. Reach Explore: nav-explore. Bottom-nav real testIDs are nav-home/nav-myhockey/nav-games/nav-explore/nav-profile (NOT 'nav-ticker'). Known crests: NHL includes CAR (first in rail); WHL includes BDN/SAS/REG/PA plus SC/PG/etc. NHL team route is /team/<ABBR> (no query); non-NHL is /team/<ABBR>?league=<code>. router.back() after a team-page tap returns to Explore with the previously opened league PANEL STILL OPEN (state preserved). Youth lens intentionally has zero explore-team-* elements and hides the league rail — this is the honest placeholder, not a bug.
